## Purpose
`/workflows/$workflowName/refine`: refine a saved workflow with AI or direct edits, through revisions. With `?execution=<id>` it opens from a failed run that the first change should fix.

## Responsibilities
`RefineWorkflowPage` reads `workflowsApi.get` and renders `components/workflows/refine/RefineWorkspace` with an optional execution id. A `WorkflowCard` serves as the header.

## Key elements
`RefineWorkflowPage`.

## Control flow
React Query.

## Data, state and side effects
Revisions, through RefineWorkspace.

## Configuration
None.

## Interactions
- **Backend:** `/api/workflows/{name}/revisions` and `/api/runs/workflow-refine`.

## Error handling and edge cases
None noted.

## Nuances and gotchas
Needs `workflows.manage`.

## How to rebuild this file
A thin page over RefineWorkspace.

None.
